# Krishiv engine metrics (v1)

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-metrics`; do not edit. -->

Engine metrics, scraped per engine (`Session::metrics`, `krishiv.metrics()`): OTel-style dotted names with the mechanical Prometheus rendering next to them (dots to underscores, `_seconds` or `_bytes` for those units, `_total` for counters; histograms expose the base name with the usual `_bucket`, `_count` and `_sum` suffixes). Units are in parentheses. Query metrics fold once per query at query end and are skipped entirely when `krishiv.metrics.enabled` is false; gauges evaluate at scrape time. Labels are bounded enums only: no principal, user, tenant, query id, session id, table, path or query text ever labels a series.

The prefixes `krishiv.stream.*`, `krishiv.ivm.*` and `krishiv.cluster.*` are reserved for streaming, incremental view maintenance and multi-node clusters; they have no entries yet.

## Histogram buckets

One set serves every histogram in v1 (the bounds are seconds, so the byte-valued `krishiv.query.memory.peak` lands in the overflow bucket until a byte set is added):

`0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 30, 60, 300` (an overflow bucket past 300 holds the rest).

The `denied` value of `status` is reserved: access-policy denials fail before execution and are not folded yet.

## Catalogue

| Dotted name | Prometheus | Kind | Unit | Labels | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `krishiv.query.count` | `krishiv_query_count_total` | counter | `{query}` | status(succeeded, failed, cancelled, denied); class(interactive, batch, background, agent); error_class | query fold | Queries that reached execution, by outcome. `error_class` is present on failed queries only, from the error-class registry. |
| `krishiv.query.duration` | `krishiv_query_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | status(succeeded, failed, cancelled, denied); class(interactive, batch, background, agent) | query fold | Wall time from the start of execution to its end, in seconds. |
| `krishiv.query.active` | `krishiv_query_active` | gauge | `{query}` | class(interactive, batch, background, agent) | scrape | Queries currently executing, by workload class. |
| `krishiv.query.cpu.time` | `krishiv_query_cpu_time_seconds_total` | counter | `s` | class(interactive, batch, background, agent) | query fold | Operator compute time summed over the query's drivers, in seconds. |
| `krishiv.query.scan.rows` | `krishiv_query_scan_rows_total` | counter | `{row}` | — | query fold | Rows file and memory scans produced, summed over the query's drivers. |
| `krishiv.query.scan.bytes` | `krishiv_query_scan_bytes_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | — | no source yet | No source yet: scans report no byte counter in the query metrics, so this entry emits nothing until one lands. |
| `krishiv.query.output.rows` | `krishiv_query_output_rows_total` | counter | `{row}` | — | query fold | Rows the query returned: rows into the result sink, summed over drivers. |
| `krishiv.query.spill.bytes` | `krishiv_query_spill_bytes_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | — | query fold | Bytes freed by serviced spills plus bytes written to spill files, summed over the query's operators. |
| `krishiv.query.spill.files` | `krishiv_query_spill_files_total` | counter | `{file}` | — | query fold | Spill files the query's operators wrote. |
| `krishiv.query.memory.peak` | `krishiv_query_memory_peak_bytes` | histogram | `By` | class(interactive, batch, background, agent) | query fold | The most bytes the query held reserved at once (an upper bound, summed over workers), in bytes. |
| `krishiv.memory.reserved` | `krishiv_memory_reserved_bytes` | gauge | `By` | — | scrape | Bytes the session's memory pool subtree holds now, in bytes. |
| `krishiv.memory.limit` | `krishiv_memory_limit_bytes` | gauge | `By` | — | scrape | The most the session's pool subtree can hold, in bytes; absent when unbounded. |
| `krishiv.memory.arbitration.spills` | `krishiv_memory_arbitration_spills_total` | counter | `1` | — | query fold | Spill requests the memory arbitrator sent, as per-query deltas of the pool tree totals. Under concurrent queries a delta may be attributed to whichever query ends first. |
| `krishiv.memory.arbitration.aborts` | `krishiv_memory_arbitration_aborts_total` | counter | `1` | — | query fold | Queries the memory arbitrator aborted, as per-query deltas of the pool tree totals (see `krishiv.memory.arbitration.spills` on attribution). |
| `krishiv.spill.disk.used` | `krishiv_spill_disk_used_bytes` | gauge | `By` | — | scrape | Bytes spill files occupy on disk now (written, not yet dropped), in bytes; zero before the first query opens the spill directory. |
| `krishiv.cache.hits` | `krishiv_cache_hits_total` | counter | `1` | cache(metadata) | query fold | File-metadata cache hits, as per-query deltas of the scheduler totals (see `krishiv.memory.arbitration.spills` on attribution). |
| `krishiv.cache.misses` | `krishiv_cache_misses_total` | counter | `1` | cache(metadata) | query fold | File-metadata cache misses, as per-query deltas of the scheduler totals (see `krishiv.memory.arbitration.spills` on attribution). |
| `krishiv.cache.evictions` | `krishiv_cache_evictions_total` | counter | `1` | cache(metadata) | no source yet | No source yet: the metadata cache keeps no eviction counter, so this entry emits nothing until one lands. |
| `krishiv.cache.size` | `krishiv_cache_size_bytes` | gauge | `By` | cache(metadata) | scrape | Bytes the file-metadata cache holds now, in bytes. |
| `krishiv.io.requests` | `krishiv_io_requests_total` | counter | `1` | op; store_kind | no source yet | No source yet: the I/O layer keeps only process-wide totals with no per-operation or per-store breakdown, so this entry emits nothing until one lands. |
| `krishiv.io.bytes.read` | `krishiv_io_bytes_read_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | op; store_kind | no source yet | No source yet: the I/O layer keeps only process-wide totals with no per-operation or per-store breakdown, so this entry emits nothing until one lands. |
| `krishiv.io.request.duration` | `krishiv_io_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | op; store_kind | no source yet | No source yet: the I/O layer keeps no per-request durations, so this entry emits nothing until they land. |
| `krishiv.exec.driver.stalls` | `krishiv_exec_driver_stalls_total` | counter | `1` | — | query fold | Driver polls longer than the stall threshold, summed over the query's drivers. |
| `krishiv.build.info` | `krishiv_build_info` | gauge | `1` | version; git_sha | scrape | The build: always 1, labelled with its version and commit. |
